speaker: big_mike
transcript:
Rich, I had a situation over here.

Guy came through the side gate hunting supplies. Asian, mid-thirties, shaved head, biker jacket.

Said he’d been following Gravitas drones because wherever those things land, somebody has medicine.

I told him to move on.

He pulled a knife.

I got behind him and broke his neck. He’s dead.

He got one shot in first, under my left rib.

Looks worse than it is. I wrapped it tight.

I’m gonna sit for a minute, catch my breath.

You stay inside, and keep the antigen off every open channel.
summary: Mike reports killing a scavenger and conceals the severity of his wound.
